verdict.rationale: The axis applies: the evidence says Server Pro includes a management API, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair thing to ask for. However, nothing in the pack mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec being published or downloadable. An API existing is not the same as a machine-readable spec for it, and llms.txt is a docs index, not an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
